title: A Modular Approach to Building a User Interface
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Multi-page forms vs. separate forms + subforms

historical_commentary.text: Building a TDI from separate per-tab forms composed via subforms, instead of one giant multi-page form, is a sound modularity principle that remains valid in modern 4D — though today it would typically be complemented (not replaced) by class-based logic and, in Project Mode, by cleanly separated form files that are much easier to diff/merge in Git.
related_updates: Project Mode (v17+) makes each form a separate text file, reinforcing the same modular-form philosophy the note argues for, now with better version-control diffing
Modern list box/panel and subform enhancements provide additional composition tools beyond what was available in 2014
